record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare ICE_SPINNER: Cetitan (2 stars) and Cetoddle (1 star); neither declares a passive in its class block. The strategy is shared; differences are star count and stats. Units not listed are not covered.
record.summary: Ring burst around the caster in 3x3 cells (the caster's own cell included), resolved cell by cell on a delay of 0, 100, 200 ... ms in row-by-row order. At each cell's turn the strategy (1) clears ALL board effects on that cell (any team, even if no enemy is there), then (2) if the entity that stood on the cell at cast time is on the other team: picks a knock-back destination from the entity's current position, deals SPECIAL damage (raw 15 / 30 at 1 / 2 stars; 60 / 120 for 3 / 4 stars exist in the table), and (3) if a destination existed, force-moves the entity there and sets its cooldown to 500. The target passed to the cast only matters for the generic pipeline: the area is centred on the caster. Damage is not conditioned on the move and the move is not conditioned on the damage, but the destination is chosen before the damage while the move happens after it.

targeting.who: entities of the other team that were on the 3x3 cells around the caster when the ability was cast (the entity is captured in the snapshot; its current position is used at execution time)
targeting.note: The cast target is used only for the default-animation arguments, which are suppressed here; the generic pipeline still needs a target to start the cast.

geometry.shape: 3x3 block centred on the caster (includesCenter = true), clipped by the board edge; order is y from caster-1 to caster+1, x from caster-1 to caster+1, so the top row (lower y) comes first and delays are 0, 100 ... up to 800 ms
geometry.knockback: orientation = board.orientation(caster position, victim's current position); destination = first EMPTY on-board cell among [orientation, then its two neighbouring orientations] (OrientationKnockback); none when all three are occupied or off board

effects.target: each enemy entity from the snapshot of the ring cells
effects.scaling: requested = table[stars-1] per hit (one hit per enemy entity at most once, since each cell is visited once). handleSpecialDamage then: x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost default true); x2 once with DOUBLE_DAMAGE (the flag is consumed by the first hit, so only one enemy of the ring gets it); x1.2 with STRANGE_STEAM_BOARD_EFFECT on either side; x critPower only if the cast crit (the cast-time boolean is reused for every hit; canCritByDefault false, so only with ABILITY_CRIT), reduced by Rocky Helmet / Black Augurite. Not conditioned on the knock-back.
effects.resolution: applied = requested after those multipliers; PokemonState.handleDamage then divides by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef), rounds up with a minimum of 1 and lets the shield absorb first; takenDamage = shield damage + HP damage (HP part capped at current hp), 0 with protect / skydiving / magicBounce. The entity in the snapshot is hit even if it moved since the cast, and an entity already at 0 hp takes nothing (handleDamage returns early). The returned takenDamage / death is not used by this ability.

effects.target: each enemy hit, when a destination exists

declaredRaw.label: one cell (or less: first free cell among three), forced displacement

effects.scaling: none (not scaled by stars, AP or crit)
effects.resolution: Requested: move to the destination computed before the damage. Applied: moveTo(..., forcedDisplacement = true) returns without moving when the victim cannot be moved (skydiving, locked, Heavy Duty Boots); otherwise the victim's cell is swapped with the destination (empty, as seen when it was chosen) and the victim's cooldown is set to 100 by moveTo. The strategy then sets cooldown = 500 whenever a destination was found, even if moveTo refused. Since the destination is chosen before the damage and a victim killed by the damage is still passed to moveTo, what moveTo does with a dead entity was not traced.

effects.target: every cell of the 3x3 block, for any team and whether or not an enemy is there

declaredRaw.label: all board effects on the cell removed

effects.resolution: clearBoardEffect without an effect argument deletes every effect of the cell from the entity standing there now and empties the cell's effect set, then broadcasts a clear event. It runs at the cell's own delay, before the damage of that cell. Which board effects exist and what removing them changes was not enumerated.

starBehavior.note: Only the damage is indexed by the casting entity's stars (four values; ?? 120 fallback). The listed units are catalog stars 2 and 1. Whether other mechanics change an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: The area is the caster's 3x3 neighbourhood clipped by the board; knock-back direction depends on the victim's position relative to the caster at execution time, and needs a free cell among three; a victim that has stepped onto the caster's cell or the same position would hit the (0,0) orientation case (confusion randomises, otherwise DOWNRIGHT).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast spends maxPP of PP and queues its own delayed commands; two casts overlapping in time would both run. Commands are pushed on the caster, and what happens to pending commands when the caster dies was not traced.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: damage 15 / 30 (1 / 2 stars) per enemy in the ring, displacement to a free adjacent cell, board-effect clear on all nine cells. Applied damage = requested x (1 + AP/100) x optional crit / double-damage / steam multipliers, then SPE_DEF division and minimum 1; takenDamage includes shield damage and is 0 with protect / skydiving / magicBounce. Applied displacement = nothing when the destination is null or the victim is unmovable; cooldown = 500 is set whenever a destination existed.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Which unit is the cast target and when the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, silence, targeting) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution - only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate was located
Where pokemon.commands is updated each tick (only SimulationCommand.update / DelayedCommand were read)
Later handleDamage branches (Shiny Charm, Fossil shield, Cover Band, death handling) were not read for this record
swapCells and toMovingState behaviour for a victim that died from the damage
unresolved: What swapCells / moveTo do with an entity killed by this ability's own damage, and whether the cell is already cleared
Which board effects exist and what their removal changes (the effect set is cleared on all nine cells)
Whether pending delayed commands are dropped when the caster dies or the fight ends before 800 ms
Interaction of the cooldown = 100 set inside moveTo with the cooldown = 500 set after it, for the attack timing of the victim, was not traced beyond the two assignments
Cover Band and other later branches of handleDamage were not read
No gameplay evidence; candidate is source reading plus mechanical checks only
